August 2015 · Apps & tools

Libo

A household-budgeting concept with a complete mobile design.

From the archive

The repository records work on 27–28 August 2015.

Libo’s homepage presents an app to make household budgeting easier. Its interface includes an expenditure overview, an add-expense flow and a record of spending.

The recovered project includes the landing page, an interactive phone layout and several original splash screens. The screens below preserve the competition-era design.
